item.description: Photo: Design: YourTango | Photo: CoffeeAndMilk from Getty Images Signature, Canva Your zodiac sign's weekly love horoscope is here for December 8 - 14, 2025, a very mixed week for love with two difficult Mars transits. The first is Mars square Saturn, which peaks on November 8, and Mars square Neptune on the 14th. Mars square Saturn is prone toward feeling blocked or cut off, as though you can’t move forward in some way. The best thing to do under this energy on Monday is to simply let it pass.
